item.title: ‘Breaking Bad’ actor and disability advocate RJ Mitte dies at 34
item.description: Breaking Bad actor and disability rights advocate R.J. Mitte died on Monday at age 34, authorities and his representatives said. Cameron County Justice of the Peace Cyndi Hinojosa told Associated Press she declared Mitte dead at about 1.30pm at what she believed was his home in Brownsville, Texas. She said she was unable to provide a cause but an autopsy will be performed. The actor lived with cerebral palsy. “It is with profound sadness that we share the tragic passing of beloved actor,... item.title: Magnetic sculpting transforms single-source fields into predetermined shapes with mathematical precision
item.description: Magnetic fields are invisible yet essential components in technologies ranging from MRI scanners and particle accelerators to atomic clocks and future quantum computers. Each of these applications requires magnetic fields with specific shapes and properties. Today, creating such tailored magnetic fields requires researchers and engineers to design specialized, carefully optimized magnets or large systems of coils for each individual application—a complex and resource-intensive process. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: David Baldacci’s Feeding Body & Mind initiative distributes over 1 million books through food banks
item.description: David and Michelle Baldacci launched Feeding Body & Mind as a dual initiative to tackle food insecurity and improve literacy rates. This program gathers and disperses books through local food banks, allowing over a million families the opportunity to take home reading materials. By linking food support with literacy resources, it empowers families to enhance their reading skills and underscores the critical need for accessible literature in challenging times.
